brief.title: Before the Numbers: When Calgary's Avenues Had Names
brief.script: Calgary's avenues once had names, not numbers. 1884 CPR townsite, Stephen Avenue, Atlantic Avenue Whisky Row, 1904 bylaw numbers, quadrants, Centre Street Bridge, downtown map, street signs, night downtown.
